name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (non-W)

module.name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 board
module.variant: Pico 2 without wireless or pre-soldered headers

record_note: Pico 2 uses RP2350A with 4 MiB external flash and a 12 MHz crystal. This binding is for the non-wireless board. Architecture selection, security boot mode, GPIO reservations, build profile, and USB/SWD flash settings still require verification.
